news.headline: STAT News Asks Why Abivax Still Hasn't Been Acquired, Nine Months Into Takeover Speculation
news.summary: STAT's Biotech Scorecard column examined why Abivax remains independent despite widely reported interest from Eli Lilly (roughly EUR 15bn) in January and an AstraZeneca exclusivity story in March, concluding the $920m July capital raise gave the company genuine financial independence and shifted leverage toward Abivax rather than any suitor. The piece frames the next move as the company's own to make, not a signal that a deal is imminent or dead.

news.headline: Abivax Named Among Three Top Immunology Takeover Targets in PharmaVoice Dealmaking Analysis
news.summary: PharmaVoice profiled Abivax alongside Spyre Therapeutics and MoonLake Immunotherapeutics as one of immunology's most talked-about M&A candidates, citing the ABTECT maintenance data (37% clinical remission and 48% endoscopic improvement at Week 44 among induction non-responders on 50 mg) and a roughly $25bn addressable IBD market by 2030. It notes CEO Marc de Garidel dismissed earlier 2026 Eli Lilly acquisition rumors as noise, and that the $920m July offering funds the company into 2029, reducing the urgency for a near-term sale.

news.headline: ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Review: Obefazimod Sustains Week-44 Remission With No Dose-Dependent Malignancy Signal
news.summary: A clinical review of the Phase 3 ABTECT Part 2 maintenance package confirmed that 37.2% of induction non-responders reached clinical remission and 34.5% endoscopic remission at Week 44 on continued 50 mg obefazimod, and that dose escalation to 50 mg recaptured clinical remission in 45.5% of patients who had relapsed in Part 1. Crucially for the June malignancy overhang, the expanded exposure showed malignancy and non-melanoma skin cancer rates consistent with UC background rates and no apparent dose-dependent signal.

news.headline: TCG Crossover and Chen Yu Report 7.0% Stake in Abivax After the July Offering
news.summary: Healthcare crossover investor TCG Crossover (Funds I and II, via managing partner Chen Yu) disclosed beneficial ownership of 6,007,834 ADSs, or 7.0% of Abivax, based on 86.09 million shares outstanding after the July 2, 2026 offering. It confirms that a dedicated biotech specialist held on through the large equity raise rather than selling into strength.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA gave constructive feedback and aligned with Abivax on the planned submission strategy, content and format of the obefazimod NDA in moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis. Abivax confirmed it remains on track to file its first-ever NDA by the end of 2026, removing a key procedural uncertainty.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $180 from $132, Maintains Overweight
news.summary: Morgan Stanley lifted its target far above the prevailing share price, citing growing confidence in the obefazimod UC data package and the NDA timeline after the maintenance results and pre-NDA FDA feedback. It sits at the top of a sell-side range whose consensus target was roughly $152-166 as of late August (BTIG $175, Jefferies Buy at $158, Leerink $148).

catalysts.label: Euronext CAC family annual index review - possible CAC 40 / CAC Next 20 / CAC Mid 60 promotion
catalysts.detail: Euronext's CAC Steering Committee meets Thursday, September 10, 2026 for the comprehensive annual review (the CAC family is also reviewed quarterly in March, June and December). The 2025 edition (decision September 11, effective September 19) moved Abivax into the CAC Mid 60 and SBF 120. With a market capitalisation now around $11bn, Abivax is a plausible candidate for a step up into a larger Paris index, which would force passive buying, but nothing has been announced and promotion is not assured.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax has this date fixed in its published financial calendar, now about two weeks out. The report will show the first post-raise balance sheet (cash was EUR 491.6m at March 31, 2026 before the $920m July offering, with runway now guided into 2029) and the step-up in R&D and pre-launch commercial spend. Expect a business update on NDA preparation, EMA filing timing and the U.S. commercial build-out alongside the numbers. This is the next scheduled company event of any kind.

catalysts.label: Full ABTECT maintenance dataset at an autumn gastroenterology congress (UEG Week)
catalysts.detail: Abivax presented two ABTECT induction late-breakers at UEG Week in Berlin in October 2025 and has a consistent pattern of taking full datasets to autumn congresses. A detailed public presentation of the Week-44 maintenance efficacy and, above all, the complete malignancy and safety database would be the cleanest way to fully retire the June cancer-signal overhang. Neither a venue nor an abstract acceptance for a 2026 autumn congress has been announced yet.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: After positive Phase 3 ABTECT induction data, the 44-week maintenance readout, the Part 2 refractory-patient dataset and the constructive pre-NDA meeting on July 30, 2026, Abivax plans to submit its first NDA for obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active UC in late Q4 2026. This is the single biggest near-term de-risking event and the gate that starts the FDA review clock. Management has reiterated the timeline at every update this year, most recently on July 30, and has built out a full commercial leadership team (four senior hires announced July 23) in anticipation.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's financial calendar lists Q3 2026 results for December 14, 2026. By then the FDA submission should either have happened or be days away, so the release is the natural venue for confirming the NDA filing and giving first guidance on review type and expected PDUFA timing. It also lands roughly three months before the March-2027 option expiry, making it the last scheduled financial update inside the option's life.

catalysts.label: MAA submission to the EMA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Abivax guided to filing a Marketing Authorization Application in Europe in the second half of 2026, contingent on the (now positive) 44-week maintenance data. Recent communication has emphasised the Q4 2026 FDA filing without restating a precise EMA date, so exact MAA timing remains unconfirmed and could slip into H1 2027. A European filing would open the second-largest UC market and is a lower-drama but real value step.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD Crohn's disease 12-week induction topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the Phase 2b induction trial of obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease are guided for mid-2027 (first patient enrolled October 2024, enrollment started Q3 2024). Management has explicitly pushed this from an earlier late-2026 expectation. A positive readout opens a second large indication for the miR-124 mechanism and is the main pipeline diversification event, but it likely lands near or just after the March-2027 option expiry.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision and U.S. launch of obefazimod
catalysts.detail: With a Q4 2026 filing and a standard review cycle, an FDA decision would fall roughly 10-12 months later, i.e. in H2 2027 - after the March-2027 call expiry. No PDUFA date exists yet because the NDA has not been submitted. The commercial organisation being hired since July 2026 is being built against this window, making it the ultimate approval and revenue catalyst for the equity.

pulse: ABVX closed at $114.79 on September 4 but climbed roughly 4-5% intraday on September 5 toward about $119, pushing back near the March-2027 $120 call's strike and a market cap around $11bn, though still well off the $148.83 52-week high; there is no confirmed company press release behind the move, but it follows STAT News' September 3 'Biotech Scorecard' feature publicly asking why nobody has acquired Abivax yet nine months after Eli Lilly and AstraZeneca takeover chatter first surfaced, which likely reignited M&A speculation even as management continues to point to the $920m July raise as proof it can go it alone into a 2029-funded solo U.S. launch. Fundamentally the story remains de-risked and execution-focused: ABTECT induction plus Week-44 maintenance data are strong, the Part 2 safety database puts malignancy rates in line with UC background rates, FDA alignment on the NDA is locked in for a filing in late Q4 2026, and a senior commercial team has been hired since July - all against a sell-side consensus target near $152-166 (Morgan Stanley $180, BTIG $175, Jefferies $158). What to watch next: the September 10 Euronext CAC family annual index review (a possible promotion given the larger market cap), the September 21 H1 2026 results (first post-raise balance sheet and an NDA/EMA timing update), a full safety-dataset presentation at an autumn congress, and any concrete confirmation or denial of renewed acquisition interest - note the Crohn's readout and any FDA approval decision both sit after the option's expiry.
